risk_notes: Entrypoint app.py may start a Gradio web UI or similar interactive server, which cannot be controlled via stdin prompt-response rules. Automated evaluation may hang or timeout if the script blocks on a web server loop.

No input() calls or stdin prompts were found in the provided excerpts, so no prompt-response rules can be defined. If the script requires interactive input at runtime,16 the current configuration will fail.
The run_config timeout is 45 seconds; if the script starts a long-lived server, the process will be killed by timeout, and no meaningful test output will be collected.
